name: Sakaki Reimi
source:
A pharmacist who ends up working at “Date Clinic.” She was sent by the protagonist’s father to assist with “the plan,” but she is a woman shrouded in mystery.

She is “useful”—exploiting her position as a pharmacist to divert drugs and procure illegal substances—but she gives off a vaguely dangerous vibe.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/9184/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
